exact.Lance Claude Code, Codex ou Gemini CLI d: Launch Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI in one of your projects with one click. A board shows running sessions; “Go there” brings the right window to the front. Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI notify the island: “waiting for your permission”, “finished”. They go through the “ondine.exe notify” command and a local channel reserved for your Windows account: nothing goes over the Internet. Hooked up as an MCP server, the island also lets the agent send you a message, a progress update, start the timer or ask you a multiple-choice question. Focus mode holds their notifications and gives you a summary at the end. If you enable it (off by default), you can also allow or deny an action from Claude Code or Codex from the island, after confirmation. The island never runs anything, never decides for you, and reads neither what you type nor the AI's replies.

Acts on the devices Windows uses by default; external screens must support DDC/CI adjustment (often enabled in their menu). Nothing is listened to or recorded: it only reads what Windows logs for its Privacy page.

exact.impossible de copier un dossier dans lui: can't copy a folder into itself

exact.trop tard : l'action n'est plus annulabl: too late: the action can no longer be undone
exact.Automatique : la langue choisie à l'inst: Automatic: the language chosen during installation, otherwise Windows' language. Windows reload.
exact.Couleur : les icônes dessinées pour Ondi: Color: the icons drawn for Ondine. Minimal: clean line icons that take the text colour (Phosphor, MIT licence).
exact.L'île reste en petite pilule au lieu de: The island stays as a small pill instead of disappearing. It only hides in presentation mode.
exact.L'île montre de fausses données (musique: The island shows fake data (music, calendar, notes, clipboard…) instead of yours. No action is really performed.
exact.La notification arrive dans l'île : lanc: The notification shows up in the island: start recording before you click.
exact.Pensez à éteindre le mode démo après vos: Remember to turn demo mode off after your screenshots.
exact.Classique : sobre. Studio : façon vidéo: Classic: understated. Studio: like a product video, items arrive blurred then sharp one after another, numbers roll, buttons bounce like jelly.
exact.Ondine s'ouvre toute seule quand vous ou: Ondine opens by itself when you sign in.
exact.Au démarrage puis une fois par jour, Ond: At startup and then once a day, Ondine checks GitHub for a new version and offers it to you. Nothing is installed without your consent.
exact.Impossible de joindre GitHub. Vérifiez v: Can't reach GitHub. Check your Internet connection.
exact.Téléchargement… Ondine va se fermer puis: Downloading… Ondine will close and come back.
exact.Installer maintenant ? Ondine se ferme q: Install now? Ondine closes for a few seconds, then comes back on its own.
exact.Un raccourci clavier (Alt+Espace par déf: A keyboard shortcut (Alt+Space by default) opens a search: Start menu apps, Windows tools (Services, Device Manager…), recent files, favorite servers (Remote access) and island actions. It also searches the island: notes and tasks, clipboard, shelf and captures. Enter to open.
exact.Une appli, un fichier, une note, une cop: An app, a file, a note, a copy… (or “10 min”)
exact.Tapez le nom d'une appli, d'un fichier,: Type the name of an app, a file, a tab, or a word from your notes.
exact.Chercher aussi dans l'île (notes, presse: Also search the island (notes, clipboard, shelf, captures)
At most 5 results per source, grouped. Excluded folders (Privacy) are never shown.
It isn't launched from the island.
exact.Le texte lu est dans le presse-papiers: The recognized text is on the clipboard
exact.Pendant une séance de travail, les notif: During a work session, the island's notifications wait (except urgent ones); they arrive at the break, with a summary. Windows banners aren't silenced: for that, start a "Focus" session in the Windows 11 Clock app.
exact.🔕 Concentration : les notifications de l: 🔕 Focus: the island's notifications wait until the session ends.
exact.QR code (pour l'ouvrir sur un téléphone): QR code (to open it on a phone)
exact.Copie l'image du QR code (noir sur blanc: Copies the QR code image (black on white) to the clipboard
exact.Visez le code avec l'appareil photo de v: Point your phone's camera at the code. Made on your PC: nothing goes over the Internet.
exact.rien à mettre dans le QR code: nothing to put in the QR code
exact.Capture une zone de l'écran avec l'outil: Captures an area of the screen with the Windows tool, then reads its text (OCR) or saves it as PNG. Also works on an image you've already copied. Text recognition runs on your computer, offline: the image is sent nowhere. The color picker copies the color of any point on the screen.
exact.Fige l'écran : cliquez sur un point pour: Freezes the screen: click a point to copy its color (Esc to cancel, arrow keys to move by one pixel)
exact.Pipette : copier une couleur de l'écran: Color picker: copy a color from the screen
exact.la pipette est déjà ouverte: the color picker is already open
exact.Travail, Maison… : les onglets, la coule: Work, Home…: tabs, color and the mini island in one go.
exact.Aussi depuis le menu de l'icône d'Ondine: Also from Ondine's icon menu, near the clock.
exact.Selon l'heure ou le Wi-Fi (règle de chaq: By time or Wi-Fi (each profile's rule below). A manual choice holds until the next change.
exact.Un profil ne retient que ce qu'il rempla: A profile only keeps what it replaces. While it's active, your changes to those settings (Tabs, Appearance…) are saved to it; other settings stay shared.
exact.Coché : le profil retient les onglets te: Checked: the profile keeps the tabs as they are now.
exact.Il faut aussi « Changer tout seul », en: Also needs "Switch automatically" at the top of the page.
exact.Une fin avant le début passe minuit (22:: An end before the start goes past midnight (22:00 → 06:00).
exact.Windows 11 ne donne ce nom qu'aux applis: Windows 11 only gives this name to apps allowed to use location (Settings → Privacy → Location).
exact.La température et le temps qu'il fait da: Temperature and current weather in your city, in the mini island when it has nothing else to show, and in detail in the System tab. Off until you check "Show the weather": nothing goes out to the Internet before that. Service: Open-Meteo (free, no account); it receives your city's name, then its rounded coordinates (about 1 km), at most every 30 minutes.
exact.Ondine demande la météo à Open-Meteo (op: Ondine asks Open-Meteo (open-meteo.com) for the weather, at most every 30 minutes.
exact.Par exemple « Lyon », ou « Lyon, FR » po: For example "Lyon", or "Lyon, FR" to specify the country.
exact.Quand rien d'autre ne s'y affiche (musiq: When nothing else shows there (music, timer, appointment).
exact.Vos prochains rendez-vous, venant de plu: Your upcoming appointments from several calendars: .ics files (exported from Outlook, Google Calendar, Thunderbird…) or the secret iCal addresses of your online calendars, each with its own name and color. A file is re-read as soon as it changes; a link is re-downloaded every 15 minutes. Clicking an appointment opens its link (Teams, Meet, Zoom meeting…). Read-only: nothing is sent, and the addresses stay in the Credential Manager.
exact.Ajoutez un fichier .ics (relu tout seul: Add an .ics file (re-read automatically when it changes) or the secret iCal address of an online calendar (Google Calendar: Settings → your calendar → “Secret address in iCal format”). The link is stored in the Windows Credential Manager, never in the settings. Keep it to yourself: it gives access to your whole calendar.
exact.Lien enregistré : l'agenda sera relu dan: Link saved: the calendar will be re-read in a few seconds.
exact.Dans les réglages du module Agenda, ajou: In the Calendar module settings, add the secret iCal address of your online calendar (Google Calendar, Outlook…), always up to date, or an exported .ics file. You can add several, each with its own color.
exact.lien refusé : seuls les liens http(s) s': link refused: only http(s) links are opened
exact.aucun lien enregistré : ajoutez-le dans: no link saved: add it in the Calendar module settings
exact.Page ouverte dans votre navigateur : rel: Page opened in your browser: check everything before sending.
exact.Ouvre GitHub avec la version, Windows et: Opens GitHub with the version, Windows and the last 40 lines of the log (personal paths hidden). You review and complete everything before sending: nothing leaves without you.
exact.Mémoire et processeur d'Ondine et de ses: Memory and CPU used by Ondine and its windows (WebView2). Measured only while this page is open.
exact.Haute : l'île réagit au plus vite. Équil: High: the island reacts as fast as possible. Balanced: the right compromise. Power saving: Ondine wakes up less often (mouse, music, system…) and keeps fewer effects.
exact.PC débranché : Ondine passe en économie: PC unplugged: Ondine switches to power saving, whatever the choice above.
exact.Pour comparer les modes : la ligne « Res: To compare modes: the “Resources used” line, further down in About.
exact.Glisser un élément vers l'Explorateur ou: Drag an item to File Explorer or the desktop to drop it there (Ctrl: copy, Shift: move).
exact.un glisser est déjà en cours: a drag is already in progress
exact.glisser vers l'extérieur : disponible se: dragging out: only available on Windows
exact.L'étagère est vide. Glissez des fichiers: The Shelf is empty. Drag files onto the island and drop them on the “Shelf” target to keep them handy.
exact.Les aides et les messages disent « vous: Help texts and messages say “vous” or “tu” (French only). Buttons don't change.
exact.La version installée de cette copie d'On: The installed version of this copy of Ondine.
Restart Claude Code to enable them.
exact.Relancez Codex, puis tapez /hooks pour l: Restart Codex, then type /hooks to approve them (Codex asks once).
Restart Gemini CLI to enable them.
exact.Ajoute les hooks d'Ondine au fichier de: Adds Ondine's hooks to the configuration file, leaving the rest untouched
exact.Un autre programme a aussi un hook Permi: Another program also has a PermissionRequest hook in Claude Code: it may answer before the island, or the other way round. Ondine did not remove it.
exact.Retire seulement les hooks d'Ondine de c: Removes only Ondine's hooks from this file
exact.Aucun hook d'Ondine dans ce fichier: No Ondine hook in this file
exact.Les autres réglages et hooks du fichier: The file's other settings and hooks are kept.
exact.✅ Installé, sans « Autoriser depuis l'îl: ✅ Installed, without "Allow from the island": reinstall to add it
exact.⚠️ Ancien chemin : ces hooks lancent un: ⚠️ Old path: these hooks run another ondine.exe, which the island refuses. Reinstall them.
exact.⚠️ Fichier illisible (JSON ou TOML inval: ⚠️ Unreadable file (invalid JSON or TOML): Ondine leaves it alone. Fix it or use the copy.
exact.⚠️ Un autre programme répond aussi aux d: ⚠️ Another program also answers permission requests (PermissionRequest): two competing answers.
exact.Choisissez l'outil, puis cliquez sur « I: Choose the tool, then click "Install automatically".
exact.Relancez l'agent, puis cliquez sur « Ess: Restart the agent, then click "Try": a notification should appear.
exact.Pour répondre aux permissions depuis l'î: To answer permissions from the island: turn on "Allow / Deny from the island" in settings, then reinstall. The agent asks nothing in auto mode.
exact.Quand Claude Code ou Codex demande la pe: When Claude Code or Codex asks permission to use a tool, the island shows you the command with "Allow" (to confirm) and "Deny". After turning it on, click "Install automatically" again (AI agents tab). The agent asks nothing in auto mode: keep it in normal mode. Without an answer, the question goes to the terminal.
exact.Demandez-lui de se réveiller, dans le La: Ask her to wake up, in the Launcher.
An old console code, with the island open.
Circle around her with the mouse.
A plane stunt, in the Launcher.
Ask the Launcher for the answer.
The first day of the year.
A day of hearts, in February.
Look closely at her back, in spring.
A June day, with music playing.
exact.Quand il fait très chaud (Météo allumée): When it is very hot (Weather on).
exact.Laissez la mini-île tranquille un bon mo: Leave the mini island alone for a good while.
exact.De temps en temps, quand la mini-île est: Now and then, when the mini island is quiet, Ondine crosses it eating its content, then everything comes back. "Try" starts it the next time the mini island shows.
Have three AI agents working at once.
exact.Un agent IA qui travaille plus d'une heu: An AI agent working for more than an hour.
Open the island in the middle of the night.
exact.Oubliez de redémarrer le PC pendant une: Forget to restart the PC for a week.
Take lots and lots of screenshots.
At the end of the week, at the end of the day.
Early in the week, in the morning.
Turn the volume all the way up.
exact.Une batterie presque vide, puis le charg: An almost empty battery, then the charger.
Copy the same thing five times.
exact.Ondine cache quelques surprises : des co: Ondine hides a few surprises: secret codes and gestures, holidays, and reactions to what happens on the PC (AI agents, night, volume…). Never during a presentation or full screen; with "reduce motion" or in power saving, the automatic surprises stay subtle.
exact.Masqués par défaut, pour garder la surpr: Hidden by default, to keep the surprise.
exact.Mode sombre de Windows : en partie (appl: Windows dark mode: partly (apps or taskbar)
exact.Windows ne permet pas de changer le mode: Windows doesn't allow changing dark mode here
exact.Windows refuse de changer l'éclairage no: Windows refused to change night light
exact.Le lecteur n'est plus visible : il a peu: The drive is no longer visible: it may already have been removed.
exact.Windows ne propose pas de retirer ce lec: Windows doesn't offer to safely remove this drive.
exact.L'Explorateur de fichiers utilise encore: File Explorer is still using this drive. Close its windows and try again.
exact.Un pilote ou un autre périphérique bloqu: A driver or another device is blocking the eject. Try again in a moment.
exact.Windows demande des droits d'administrat: Windows requires administrator rights to eject this drive.
exact.Windows ne permet pas d'éjecter ce lecte: Windows doesn't allow ejecting this drive.
exact.Un programme utilise encore la clé. Ferm: A program is still using the USB drive. Close it and try again.
exact.Un programme utilise encore le disque. F: A program is still using the disk. Close it and try again.
exact.ce lecteur n'est plus branché: this drive is no longer plugged in
exact.Prévenir quand une clé USB est branchée: Notify when a USB drive is plugged in
exact.Avec deux boutons : « Ouvrir » et « Éjec: With two buttons: "Open" and "Eject". Plugged-in USB drives and disks can also be ejected from the tab.
exact.Redémarrage en attente depuis moins d'un: Restart pending for less than an hour
exact.Windows attend un redémarrage pour termi: Windows is waiting for a restart to finish its updates. Restart whenever it suits you.
exact.Rappeler un redémarrage en attente: Remind me of a pending restart
exact.Au plus une fois par jour, après un jour: At most once a day, after a day of waiting, never during a call or a presentation. Ondine never restarts the PC itself.

patterns: ^Autoriser\ /\ Refuser\ depuis\ l'île\ \((.+?)\)\ :\ quand\ (.+?)\ demande\ une\ permission,\ l'île\ montre\ la\ commande\ avec\ «\ Autoriser\ »\ \(à\ confirmer\)\ et\ «\ Refuser\ »\.\ Sans\ réponse\ à\ temps,\ la\ question\ passe\ au\ terminal\.\ Collez\ ce\ hook\ en\ plus,\ de\ la\ même\ façon\.$

Allow / Deny from the island ($1): when $2 asks for a permission, the island shows the command with "Allow" (to confirm) and "Deny". If there's no reply in time, the question falls back to the terminal. Paste this hook in addition, the same way.
^(.+?)\ est\ sur\ un\ lecteur\ sans\ Corbeille\ \(clé\ USB,\ réseau…\)\ :\ l'île\ ne\ supprime\ jamais\ définitivement,\ faites\-le\ vous\-même\ si\ vous\ êtes\ sûr$
$1 is on a drive without a Recycle Bin (USB stick, network…): the island never deletes permanently, do it yourself if you're sure
^«\ \.(.+?)\ »\ n'est\ pas\ pris\ en\ charge\ :\ un\ fichier\ texte\ \(\.txt,\ \.log,\ code…\)\ ou\ une\ image\ \(\.png,\ \.jpg\)$
“.$1” is not supported: use a text file (.txt, .log, code…) or an image (.png, .jpg)
^(.+?)\ est\ déjà\ utilisé\ par\ un\ autre\ logiciel\ :\ choisissez\ un\ autre\ raccourci\ dans\ les\ réglages\ du\ Lanceur$
$1 is already used by another program: pick another shortcut in the Launcher settings
^(.+?)\ est\ déjà\ pris\ par\ un\ autre\ logiciel\ :\ choisissez\ un\ autre\ raccourci\ dans\ les\ réglages\ de\ Contrôles$
$1 is already taken by another program: pick another shortcut in the Controls settings
^(.+?)\ a\ été\ mis\ à\ l'écart\ après\ trois\ plantages\.\ Il\ revient\ au\ prochain\ démarrage\ de\ l'appli\.$
$1 was sidelined after three crashes. It will return at the app's next launch.
^(.+?)\ est\ déjà\ pris\ par\ un\ autre\ logiciel\ :\ choisissez\ un\ autre\ raccourci\ dans\ Réglages\ >\ Général$
$1 is already taken by another program: pick another shortcut in Settings > General
^⏳\ Pas\ de\ réponse\ de\ (.+?)\ sur\ le\ port\ (.+?)\ :\ serveur\ éteint,\ ou\ un\ pare\-feu\ bloque$
⏳ No response from $1 on port $2: server is off, or a firewall is blocking
^Collez\-le\ dans\ (.+?),\ puis\ activez\ le\ réglage\ «\ Autoriser\ /\ Refuser\ depuis\ l'île\ »\.$
Paste it into $1, then turn on the "Allow / Deny from the island" setting.
^Règle\ «\ (.+?)\ »\ supprimée\ \(«\ Annuler\ »\ dans\ l'île\ pendant\ quelques\ secondes\)\.$
Rule “$1” deleted (“Undo” in the island for a few seconds).
^le\ serveur\ refuse\ cette\ adresse\ \(code\ (.+?)\)\ :\ recopiez\ l'adresse\ secrète\ iCal$
the server refuses this address (code $1): copy the secret iCal address again
^(.+?)\ minutes\ d'écran\ :\ levez\-vous,\ regardez\ au\ loin,\ buvez\ un\ verre\ d'eau\.$
$1 minutes of screen time: stand up, look into the distance, drink a glass of water.
unable to move: $1 (incomplete copy left in $2)
^⛔\ Port\ (.+?)\ fermé\ :\ (.+?)\ répond,\ mais\ rien\ n'écoute\ sur\ ce\ port$
⛔ Port $1 closed: $2 responds, but nothing is listening on this port
^(.+?)\ ne\ remplit\ pas\ les\ conditions\ :\ la\ règle\ ne\ ferait\ rien\.$
$1 does not meet the conditions: the rule would do nothing.
^copié,\ mais\ l'original\ n'a\ pas\ pu\ aller\ à\ la\ Corbeille\ :\ (.+?)$
copied, but the original could not be sent to the Recycle Bin: $1
^(.+?)\ :\ pas\ une\ image\ lisible\ \(PNG,\ JPEG,\ WebP,\ BMP\ ou\ GIF\)$
$1: not a readable image (PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP or GIF)
^le\ module\ (.+?)\ a\ été\ mis\ à\ l'écart\ après\ plusieurs\ plantages$
module $1 was sidelined after several crashes
^(.+?)\ pour\ ouvrir\ ·\ ↑\ ↓\ pour\ choisir\ ·\ Entrée\ pour\ ouvrir$
$1 to open · ↑ ↓ to choose · Enter to open
^le\ serveur\ a\ répondu\ (.+?),\ nouvel\ essai\ dans\ 15\ minutes$
the server answered $1, retrying in 15 minutes
^écrivez\ un\ modèle\ de\ nom,\ par\ exemple\ «\ vacances\-(.+?)\ »$
write a name pattern, for example “holidays-$1”
the Snipping Tool does not open (code $1)
^Plus\ que\ (.+?)\ %\ :\ pensez\ à\ brancher\ le\ chargeur\.$
Only $1% left: remember to plug in the charger.
^Rien\ de\ prévu\ dans\ les\ (.+?)\ prochains\ jours\.\ 🌴$
Nothing planned in the next $1 days. 🌴
module $1 does not have the “$2” permission
^impossible\ de\ créer\ le\ dossier\ du\ ticket\ :\ (.+?)$
unable to create the ticket folder: $1
^(.+?)\ image\(s\)\ créée\(s\)\ à\ côté\ des\ originales$
$1 image(s) created next to the originals
^(.+?)\ est\ déjà\ utilisé\ par\ un\ autre\ logiciel$
$1 is already used by another program
^«\ (.+?)\ »\ est\ un\ nom\ réservé\ par\ Windows$
“$1” is a name reserved by Windows
^(.+?)\ a\ lancé\ un\ minuteur\ de\ (.+?)\ min$
^(.+?)\ n'est\ pas\ installé\ sur\ ce\ PC$
$1 is not installed on this PC
$1 is no longer in the Recycle Bin
at most $1 files at a time
Open the island on the $1 tab
^Je vis en haut de l'écran : passez la souris tout en haut, ou (.+)\. Mon icône est près de l'horloge \(clic droit : Réglages, Quitter\)\.$
I live at the top of the screen: move the mouse to the very top, or press $1. My icon is next to the clock (right-click: Settings, Quit).
^texte\ trop\ long\ pour\ un\ QR\ code\ \((\d+)\ caractères,\ (\d+)\ au\ plus\)$
text too long for a QR code ($1 characters, $2 at most)
^«\ (.+?)\ »\ est\ actif\.\ Aussi\ depuis\ le\ menu\ de\ l'icône\ d'Ondine,\ près\ de\ l'horloge\.$
"$1" is active. Also from Ondine's icon menu, near the clock.
^(.+) : aucun lien enregistré : ajoutez-le dans les réglages du module Agenda$
$1: no link saved: add it in the Calendar module settings
^Trésor\ trouvé\ \((\d+)\ /\ (\d+)\)\ :\ à\ retrouver\ dans\ Réglages\ →\ Mascotte\.$
^Vous pouvez retirer la clé ([A-Z]:) en toute sécurité\.$
You can safely remove the USB drive $1.
^Vous pouvez retirer le disque ([A-Z]:) en toute sécurité\.$
You can safely remove the disk $1.
^Windows refuse l'éjection \(code (\d+)\)\. Réessayez dans un moment\.$
Windows refused to eject (code $1). Try again in a moment.
^Le service « (.+) » utilise encore ce lecteur\. Réessayez dans un moment\.$
The "$1" service is still using this drive. Try again in a moment.
^« (.+) » utilise encore ce lecteur\. Fermez-le puis réessayez\.$
"$1" is still using this drive. Close it and try again.
